review_type: single AI curator; full received final answer read; model identity visible

errors.quote: Isotopic phosphate labeling to prove de novo synthesis
errors.issue: Label incorporation can reflect ATP-phosphate exchange, including exchange before release of a bound pool. The design has useful solution ATP quantification but no measured total initial bound/device inventory or repeated-turnover criterion to establish net new ATP beyond it.

errors.quote: ATP accumulates during reverse rotation and does not accumulate during no-rotation or zero-net-rotation periods.
errors.issue: Equal forward/reverse angular displacement need not cancel chemistry under changing substrates, asymmetric kinetics, product removal or slippage. Positive ATP under oscillation is not by itself contamination; this categorical negative-control rule is too strong.

This follows Phase 5 adding ATP to verify rotation, yet then collects a final chemical sample. That sample cannot be used as synthesis evidence unless separated from the ATP challenge; collect synthesis samples before ATP addition or use sister chambers.

errors.quote: Subtract no-enzyme and no-rotation backgrounds using the predefined statistical model.
errors.issue: These backgrounds overlap and should be handled through explicit contrasts rather than assumed additive subtraction. The conceptual full-interaction model also needs an identifiable design and lower-order terms or a justified equivalent parameterization.

errors.quote: ## Minimal acceptable evidence for a strong claim
errors.issue: At 5976 words, the answer exceeds the 5000-word limit and repeats protocol, calibration, control and acceptance sections. This is a communication deduction separate from the chemical-inference and sampling errors.

rationale: Strong orientation control, empirical mechanics, direct nucleotide separation, independent chambers and quantified negative controls. Its isotope claim does not fully establish new product beyond initial bound inventory, the zero-net-angle control is overinterpreted, and final sampling occurs after an ATP challenge. The long repeated answer needs both scientific corrections and editing.
reference_guardrails: The packet establishes ATP-associated directional motion, not an ATP-per-turn yield, torque, universal camera sign or completed reverse-synthesis experiment. Proposed numerical settings may earn credit when explicitly qualified.
Correct the draft reference by explicitly requiring magnesium/cofactor and nucleotide speciation qualification; its generic reaction inventory is not a complete buffer recipe.
Reverse operation should generate new ATP repeatedly beyond measured initial available/bound pools. Three catalytic sites are not a universal total ATP-contamination bound.

Luciferase is an acceptable chemical readout when its consumption, recovery and time response are calibrated. An intensity slope is not generally synthesis flux; chromatographic detection is an alternative, not mandatory.
Label incorporation can reflect exchange. Pair isotope provenance with net-product/material balance; account for reporter consumption and sample removal as appropriate.
Empirical direction, mixed surface orientations, actual rotor turns and transmitted torque are distinct quantities. Do not replace any with the nominal actuator command.

Mechanical input can drive ATP synthesis uphill. Low initial ATP may aid sensitivity but does not prove positive chemical-energy storage; energetic efficiency needs both work and chemical free energy.

ATP per turn is a coupling yield, not energetic efficiency. Inactive fractions, orientation, incomplete entrainment and analytical recovery can reduce apparent yield without establishing loose molecular coupling.
Separate ADP and phosphate controls help discriminate intended synthesis from alternative ATP production. Inhibitor effects require assay and enzyme specificity validation.

Matching is retrospective and applies all five predeclared components. A partially correct historical direction is recorded even when the experimental design is flawed; no claim of prospective novelty or uncontaminated holdout is made.
